content_of_post_to_answer: What mindset shifts help people transition from financial struggle to financial success?
answer: The biggest shift is moving from asking “How can I make more money?” to “How can I become less financially fragile?” Higher income helps, but without understanding spending, managing risk, and building a buffer, even a good salary can leave someone one emergency away from struggle. Financial success begins when money stops being merely something to spend and becomes something that creates options. The real goal is not looking wealthy, but becoming harder to destabilize.
